_README: The Phase 3 gate (CLAUDE.md Section 8): verify_section() must be 100% correct
on 10 real and 10 fabricated section numbers. Binary gate.
The fabricated ones are chosen to be the fabrications a model actually makes,
not random noise: a number that is real in the OTHER code (BNS 420, BNS 498A -
the union error), one past the end of a code (IPC 512, BNS 359), a plausible
letter suffix that does not exist (IPC 120C, 302A, 379Z; BNS 303A), and
The real ones include the awkward cases: a suffixed section (120B), a section
whose text had to be patched in from the official text (304B), a repealed
section that is still a section (IPC 13 - a lawyer citing it must be told it
was repealed, not that it does not exist), and both ends of the BNS (1, 358).
Every 'real' entry was checked against the ingested corpus before being listed;
every 'fabricated' one was checked to be absent from it.
